title: Big Plate House (Give It A Good Old Rub)
The Rub
style: Euphoric hard house remix, festival dance, 150 BPM, Eb major, four-on-the-floor kick, offbeat bass, bright supersaw chords, pitched-up sing-along vocal hook, crowd chant, build-up and drop, club anthe
lyrics:
[verse]
One pea, forty quid, give it a good old rub
One plate, full size, that's how I get it done

[build]
Big plate, big plate, hands in the air
Big plate, big plate, feel the sound

[chorus]
Give it a good old rub, give it a good old rub
Give it a good old rub, give it a good old rub
We belong in the crowd, we belong in the sound
Big plate, big plate, we never stop around

[drop]
Give it a good old rub
Rub it, rub it, rub it
Big plate, big plate, feel the beat
Give it a good old rub
